transcript: Come with us to sit second row at Hamilton after I won the ticket lottery for the first time. I've lived in New York for six years and had never won the lottery before so this was very exciting and I had to take my friend Surat who had never seen it performed live. The seats were great but not perfect. A pro of being this close is that you really get to take in the acting and the facial expressions but I think a con is that some of the big lighting and choreo moments aren't as effective cause you can't really see everything at once. But really for $10, you can complain? Obviously Hamilton is great show, but in this cast particularly, I was really impressed by the acting of Burr, Angelica, and Lafayette/Jefferson oh and Peggy/Maria Reynolds — their vocals were just amazing. So if you've never won the Hamilton lottery before, keep trying cause I lived here for six years before my time came — yours will too.
reasoning: Clear positive recommendation with enthusiastic language ('Obviously Hamilton is great show') and specific praise for cast performances, while acknowledging minor seating drawbacks.
